digest.component_or_area: Jira DC test harness and external integration
propositions: Atlassian ended Data Center trial licenses and publishes no OpenAPI spec for DC, making contract testing against a real instance necessary; existing fake verification cannot falsify unstated assumptions about REST v2 semantics, transitions, or permission errors.

The vendored Dockerfile builds from addono/jira-software-standalone by pinned digest and reproduces atlas-run with mandatory -DskipAllPrompts=true (prevents Marketplace v1 endpoint failure on every cold start) and -Dproduct.start.timeout (prevents Cargo's 600s deploy ceiling from silently killing boot on slow runners).

The compose service must pin platform: linux/amd64 explicitly, set tty: true and stdin_open: true (AMPS requires a controlling TTY), bind loopback-scoped 127.0.0.1:2990:2990 (not 0.0.0.0; instance has well-known admin/admin credentials), and mount a persistent ~/.m2 cache volume (atlas-run downloads ~900 Maven artifacts at runtime, not included in the image).

The smoke tests prove PAT bearer authentication works against a real 8.17.1 instance by minting a token via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and using it in an Authorization: Bearer request, and verify REST v2 semantics (create/read round-trip with string-valued description, not ADF) and deployment classification (Jira 8.x Server, not Cloud).

Teardown is index-independent per ADR 0037: each created issue is polled at its direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404, never queried via search, because Jira's search index lags creates and deletes by an unbounded interval and can return stale results either way.

The external-integration.yml workflow gains a separate amd64 job that builds the Dockerfile, waits on readiness with a 20-minute budget (native amd64 achieves ~3-5 minutes; emulated arm64 exceeds 10 minutes and Cargo kills boot), runs only tests/external/live_jira_dc/, and tears down in an if: always() step; the pre-existing LLM-keyed job adds --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc to prevent canary masking when DC tests skip due to no harness.
